newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCorp Centralia, Wash. unit back up.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCorp Centralia, Wash. unit back up.

text.p: A 670 megawatt (MW) unit at Pacificorp's Centralia, Wash., coal-fired power plant was restarted, as expected, late Friday after it tripped off Wednesday, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Monday.
A Pacificorp official said earlier that a boiler tube leak would be repaired during the brief outage.
PacifiCorp operates and owns 47.5 percent of the plant.
Centralia's other 670 MW unit was also operating at full capacity, the sources said.
